annotation.evidence_span: MUST record the time it was received
annotation.interpretation_a: The recipient records the time *immediately* upon receiving the message.
annotation.interpretation_b: The recipient records the time after some delay or processing of the message.
annotation.justification: The phrase "MUST record the time it was received" is open to interpretation regarding the timing of the recording. Is it instantaneous upon receipt, or can it be delayed? This affects the accuracy of the Date header and thus implementation behaviour.
annotation.missing_information: The clause does not specify *when* the recipient must record the time. This could affect how accurately the Date header reflects the original server's time.
